icons.name: arrow-right
icons.heading: Arrow right
icons.description: The arrow goes right. Light: it launches right along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

Strong: they pull out first, launch in harder with speed streaks behind them, and the fresh set lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.
